newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Yemeni man for killing compatriot.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Yemeni man for killing compatriot.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Yemeni man on Sunday for stabbing a compatriot to death during an argument, Saudi state-run television reported.
An interior ministry statement carried by the television said the victim died after being stabbed twice with a knife. It gave no further details.
The beheading, in the Red Sea coastal city of Jeddah, raised to 62 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
